Read capillary scans

Source: R/read.R
read_mst_capillary_scan.Rd

Reads a Capillary Scan export: the raw fluorescence across the tray before each measurement, which is used to check for sticking, aggregation and pipetting errors.

Usage

read_mst_capillary_scan(path)

Arguments

path

Path to an .xlsx file exported from MO.Affinity Analysis, or a .moc or .nta project file.

Value

A tibble with one row per scan position per capillary. Alongside the sample and measurement settings of each capillary, it has columns:

  • included: FALSE if the capillary was marked as an outlier.

  • position: position along the tray, in capillary index units.

  • fluorescence: raw fluorescence counts.

Project files give some extra columns; see the Project files section of read_mst().

Examples

read_mst_capillary_scan(tidymst_example("dppr10c2_capillary-scan.xlsx"))
#> # A tibble: 28,418 × 16
#>    merge_set run             capillary measured_at         capillary_type ligand
